_note: The body of the probability box. It is built around a knowledge core because that is what the machine really is: a core that has been taught to gamble the essentia it is fed against the knowledge it pays out. Everything else is the middle of the mod's own ladder - an entropy core for the chance it takes, a flux crystal for the taint that chance leaves behind, a formation core and a calculation processor for pulling a result out of nothing - so a player with an altar and a first essentia line can build it. Instability 8 is the highest in this mod (the flux interface sits at 7): the box is a gamble, and the altar is meant to feel it.
_crystal: The cognitio vis crystal is matched as a component rather than as a plain item, the shape vis_connection_card.json already uses: the aspect lives in a data component, so an item-only ingredient could not name it. It is also the aspect the box runs on, which is what the 32 points of cognitio below are paid in.
_gate: Locked on the box's own research entry, which is the entry that asks for a brain in a jar as a parent: the recipe is hidden in JEI and refused by the altar until stage 2 is known.
_brain: No jar brain among the components on purpose. The box takes its brain by hand after it is built - the slot, the binding and the owner all come from that click - so an ingredient would charge the player a second brain for the same step.
